description: This Rust source file implements a web server routing module for mapping HTTP requests to SQL files, static assets, or error pages based on a set of routing rules, including site prefix handling, path resolution, and error handling with custom 404 pages.

classes.name: RoutingAction
classes.description: Enum representing possible routing actions: executing SQL files, serving static assets, redirecting, or handling not found errors.

classes.name: AppFileStore
classes.description: Struct implementing FileStore trait, encapsulating cache, filesystem, and app state for file existence checks.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Struct implementing RoutingConfig trait, holding routing configuration such as site prefix.

methods.name: calculate_route
methods.description: Main function to determine routing action based on request path and query, file store, and routing configuration.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks and decodes the request path, applying site prefix handling and path decoding.

methods.name: calculate_route_without_extension
methods.description: Handles routing logic for paths without file extensions, including directory index resolution and redirection.

methods.name: find_file_or_not_found
methods.description: Attempts to find a file with a specific extension; if not found, proceeds to error handling.

methods.name: find_file
methods.description: Checks if a specific file exists and returns appropriate routing action.

methods.name: find_not_found
methods.description: Walks up directory tree to find a custom 404 handler file.

methods.name: append_to_path
methods.description: Appends a string to the request path to form a new URI, used for redirection.
